title: Dutch Rice Pilaf
description: A delicious and easy-to-make pilaf dish with a Dutch twist.
instructions: Heat 2 tablespoons of light in a large saucepan over medium heat.
Add 1 teaspoon of dutch and cook for 1 minute.
Add 1 cup of chewy and cook for 2 minutes.
Add 1 cup of rice and cook for 2 minutes.
Add 2 cups of pilaf and stir to combine.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low and cover.
Simmer for 18-20 minutes or until the liquid is absorbed.
Fluff the pilaf with a fork and serve hot.
